result.topic_en: Conclusion of a derivation of geodesic lines on an ellipsoid via a complete integral V in elliptic coordinates lambda and mu, with the geodesic relation obtained by differentiating V with respect to the constant alpha.
result.transcription:
$V = \int\sqrt{\frac{\lambda(\alpha-\frac{1}{2}h\lambda)}{L}}\cdot d\lambda + \int\sqrt{\frac{\mu(\frac{1}{2}h\mu-\alpha)}{M}}$
folgt. Die Relation zwischen $\lambda$ und $\mu$, welche die geodätische
Linie bestimmt, wird $\frac{dV}{d\alpha} = \mathfrak{b}$ oder
$2\mathfrak{b} = \int\sqrt{\frac{\lambda}{(\alpha-\frac{1}{2}h\lambda)L}}\cdot d\lambda - \int\sqrt{\frac{\mu}{(\frac{1}{2}h\mu-\alpha)M}}\cdot d\mu$
wo $h$, $\alpha$ und $\mathfrak{b}$ die willkürlichen Constanten sind.

methods.what: Complete integral (Hamilton–Jacobi type) of the geodesic problem in elliptic coordinates on the ellipsoid, separated into lambda and mu parts
Equation of the geodesic obtained by differentiating the complete integral with respect to the arbitrary constant alpha (Jacobi's method)
